fusions.name: Portcullis Bite
fusions.desc: Your jaws shut on the target for 13 damage, stunning it for 1.4 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Falling Bars
fusions.desc: Snaps your jaws through a narrow cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage with a 40% chance to leave each enemy [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Sunken Jaws
fusions.desc: Sets a pair of jaws under the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 3 tiles takes 18 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Locked In
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
